name: imagestorage
description: A desktop visual reference canvas with saved boards and sticky notes.
author: ImageStorage

scripts.extension:test: node browser-extension/build.mjs --test && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && node --test tests/browser-extension.test.mjs tests/inline-picker.test.mjs tests/batch-save.test.mjs tests/batch-picker.test.mjs tests/pinterest-board-file.test.mjs tests/pinterest-board-ui.test.mjs
scripts.extension:integration:test: node browser-extension/build.mjs --test && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && node --test tests/extension-background.test.mjs
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:icons && npm run extension:build && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && electron-builder --dir
scripts.desktop:build:unsigned: npm run desktop:icons && npm run extension:build && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && electron-builder --win portable nsis --publish never -c.directories.output=work/unsigned-release
scripts.test: npm run build && node browser-extension/build.mjs --test && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs tests/desktop-regressions.test.mjs tests/windows-signing.test.mjs tests/store-packaging.test.mjs tests/editor-debug.test.mjs tests/persistence-debug.test.mjs tests/ui-debug.test.mjs tests/list-manager-pointer-drag.test.mjs tests/diagnostics.test.mjs tests/canvas-settings.test.mjs tests/note-settings.test.mjs tests/image-drop.test.mjs tests/storage-tools.test.mjs tests/extension-bridge.test.mjs tests/browser-extension.test.mjs tests/inline-picker.test.mjs tests/batch-save.test.mjs tests/batch-picker.test.mjs tests/pinterest-board-file.test.mjs tests/pinterest-board-ui.test.mjs
